checks.friend rooms / quick match: Quick match (RIFT, Lantern Drill) starts offline in every run. Friend rooms and online quick match were NOT run end to end: vale-net refuses a localhost origin and the network code has not changed since live.

problems: Cannot reproduce here: no Windows, no Chrome on ANGLE Direct3D 11, no Intel or AMD integrated GPU, no GPU watchdog. All compile timings are Metal timings. Whether the tester's freeze is gone depends on the device report (Settings > Video > Copy device report) from that laptop.
The match fragment programs are unchanged: up to 140 KB with 11 loops. They are now compiled with polling behind the loading screen, but are no cheaper for the D3D11 driver (FXC) to compile.

Goal 2 (load fast) is only partly done. Bytes to Home are unchanged (4.1 MB, 25 requests). Match bytes are down by only 3 % (Practice) and 6-10 % (Quick), though requests are down 24-38 %. There is no KTX2/Basis compression. Practice Start-to-view is the same as live (11.9 s); only the loading screen is a little faster.
Software rendering is still very slow (3.5 fps, tasks up to 5.3 s). It does not hang, and the plate warns first.
High 5v5 heap + GPU is about 1.5 GB by my estimate, unchanged from live. It is not 'well under 1.5 GB' on strong GPUs; the at-risk class (Low) is at 0.5-0.6 GB.
The Medium tier (Iris Xe / AMD integrated string) was not measured; only the Intel UHD 620 -> Low path was.
WebKit and Firefox were not tested: Playwright has no webkit or firefox browsers installed on this Mac (no ms-playwright cache), and installing them is a download that was not authorised here.

On a context loss the 'Restoring the view' plate shows and frames run at 60 fps, but the plate was still up 6 s after restoreContext() in both live and new. This is not a regression, but recovery time was not confirmed.
verdict: Pass. The hard bar that failed in r1 (no stall over 250 ms after first paint) is now met on the weak profile with room to spare, against 1.2-1.6 s freezes in live. Home is usable 1.5 s sooner, an Intel UHD string starts on Low at about 0.55 GB, software rendering gets a plain plate and never hangs, and the High look and strong-device timings are unchanged or slightly better. Load-size work (KTX2, fewer bytes) is still thin, and the real Windows/D3D11 freeze cannot be confirmed from this Mac.
